name: Vault finder
responsibility: Finds a command's vault the way git finds its repository: from -C or the working directory, at the checkout root
description: TASK-472.09. No environment variable names a vault any longer: a set ARCHBOARD_VAULT is refused before the command runs, and the finder's origin is -C or working-directory. locateVault finds the vault; a command asks through findVault in Vault address. vaultIn(directory) is the vault a directory holds when the server serves it: a .archboard/vault whose real directory is in the layout. A vault named directly is one when vaultIn(checkoutOfVault(real)) === real, which is how the server and the workbench check a named vault now that isVaultLayout is private (TASK-653.10). The finder refuses a vault whose link leads out of that layout as VAULT_NOT_FOUND (reason vault-outside-layout), before the command registers anything. TASK-480: in a checkout with no vault, the finder asks the lookup it is given for the known vaults whose models bind the checkout's repository, and the refusal names each one as the -C to give, with its models.
